_comment: THE ONE FILE THAT DECIDES WHICH MODELS EXIST.
Adding a row packs a new model on the next `pack_model.py --all`;
removing one stops it being rebuilt (the served .glb is not deleted for
you -- delete it yourself, so a removal is never silent data loss).
Same shape and same reasoning as scripts/map_manifest.json, which
CLAUDE.md already describes as the one owner of which maps exist. Before
this file the source-directory -> asset-key mapping lived only in
whatever anyone last typed on the command line, which is why it could not
be rebuilt in a batch and why the texture ceiling drifted per model.
source    -- directory under assets/ holding scene.gltf. Its FIRST path
component is the family, and the family decides the
texture ceiling and byte budget (see asset_budgets.py).
asset_key -- the statefeed asset key. Names the served file, because
that is what blackout_models.js registers and what a Godot
The served tree mirrors the source tree: assets/npcs/<x> -> models/npcs/.
There is deliberately no way to redirect that from here.
